description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Update only preferences the owner explicitly requested. Read front_desk first. Show changes to payment links, optional suggestions and spending preferences before saving them. A new payment link, a different phone to put callers through to (transferPhone) and, with an active plan, a higher spending limit wait for the owner’s OK in their dashboard (waiting_for_owner, approval_id; front_desk lists pending_approvals); everything else in the call changes at once. complete: true marks setup finished; it never activates voice, ports a number, collects a card or enforces billing. Knowledge is edited and published separately with update_receptionist.

quietHours.description: [from, to] times "HH:MM" (24-hour, the business’s time) when its texts don’t go out, e.g. ["21:00", "08:00"]; the default is only ["00:00", "00:05"]; equal times for none. The owner’s call: they know their customers.
